examples.en: The baked sweet potato tasted so nutty that I ate one more.

examples.ko: 겨울 저녁에는 군고구마 냄새가 골목에 퍼져요.
examples.en: On winter evenings, the smell of baked sweet potatoes spreads through the alley.
Baked sweet potatoes are tastiest when eaten warm.
I bought two baked sweet potatoes on the street.
I eat baked sweet potato with dongchimi (radish water kimchi) on the side.
I tried making baked sweet potatoes in the oven.

explain: 겨울에 먹는 대표적인 간식이에요. '구운 고구마'라고 해도 되지만 간식 이름으로는 '군고구마'라고 많이 말해요.

phrases.example: 추운 날 길에서 군고구마를 사 먹었어요.
phrases.en: On a cold day, I bought a baked sweet potato on the street and ate it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 겨울 길거리에서 파는 간식을 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for the snack sold on the street in winter.
phrases.en_equiv: buy and eat a baked sweet potato

phrases.en: I smell baked sweet potatoes in the alley.
phrases.nuance_ko: '냄새가 나다'와 같이 써서 겨울 분위기를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with 'smell' to describe the winter atmosphere.

phrases.en: Baked sweet potatoes are sweet and warm, so I like them.
phrases.nuance_ko: '군고구마'와 뜻이 같지만 집에서 직접 구운 것을 말할 때도 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as the head word, and natural for ones baked at home too.

explain_en: It is a classic winter snack. You can say '구운 고구마' too, but '군고구마' is the usual name for the snack.

examples.en: Before going to work I had a muffin with coffee.
On the weekend I baked muffins in the oven at home.

examples.ko: 이 카페는 블루베리 머핀이 정말 맛있어요.
examples.en: This cafe's blueberry muffin is really tasty.
Please wrap up two muffins to go.
This muffin is very moist and soft.

examples.ko: 머핀 위에 초콜릿 칩이 많이 올라가 있어요.
examples.en: There are lots of chocolate chips on top of the muffin.

explain: 머핀은 케이크보다 빵에 가깝고, 위에 크림을 듬뿍 올려 꾸민 건 '컵케이크'라고 불러요. 카페에서는 '블루베리 머핀', '초코 머핀'처럼 재료 이름을 앞에 붙여서 불러요. 커피와 함께 아침 대신 먹는 사람도 많아요.

phrases.en: One blueberry muffin, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 카페에서 재료 이름을 앞에 붙여 주문해요.
phrases.nuance_en: At cafes you order by putting the ingredient in front.

phrases.en: The chocolate muffin is the tastiest.
phrases.nuance_ko: '초코'는 '초콜릿'을 줄인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: 초코 is short for chocolate.

phrases.en: I baked muffins for the kids.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집에서 만들 때는 '굽다'를 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 굽다 when you make them at home.

explain_en: A muffin is closer to bread than cake, and one decorated with a lot of cream on top is called a 컵케이크. At cafes the flavor goes in front, as in '블루베리 머핀' (blueberry muffin) and '초코 머핀' (chocolate muffin). Many people have one with coffee instead of breakfast.

examples.ko: 비 오는 날에는 부침개가 먹고 싶어요.
examples.en: I want to eat buchimgae on rainy days.
Be careful when you flip a hot buchimgae.
I put plenty of green onions into the buchimgae batter.
This shop's buchimgae is crispy on the outside.
I ate two buchimgae for lunch.

examples.ko: 명절에 온 가족이 모여 부침개도 부쳐요.
examples.en: On holidays the whole family gathers and makes buchimgae too.

explain: 같은 음식을 '전'이라고도 해요. 파전, 김치전처럼 재료 이름 뒤에 '전'을 붙여 말하는 경우가 많고, '부침개'는 일상에서 두루 쓰는 이름이에요. 동사는 '부치다'를 써서 '부침개를 부치다'라고 해요.

phrases.example: 명절에는 가족과 함께 전을 많이 부쳐요.
phrases.en: On holidays, we make lots of jeon with the family.
phrases.nuance_ko: '부침개'와 같은 음식을 부르는 짧은 말로, 명절이나 식당에서 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A shorter name for the same dish as 부침개, often used for holidays and in restaurants.

phrases.en: On rainy days, I crave kimchi pancakes.
phrases.nuance_ko: 재료 이름 뒤에 '전'을 붙인 말로, 부침개의 한 종류를 정확히 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Ingredient name plus 전; used to name a specific kind of 부침개.

phrases.en: On the weekend, I made buchimgae with my mom.
phrases.nuance_ko: '부침개'와 가장 자주 함께 쓰는 동사로, 음식을 만들 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb most often paired with 부침개, used when making the dish.

explain_en: The same food is also called '전'. People often say '파전' or '김치전' with the ingredient in front, while '부침개' is the general everyday name. The verb is '부치다', so you say '부침개를 부치다' (to pan-fry buchimgae).

examples.en: I went to have sundaetguk for lunch with a friend.
I add a little salted shrimp to my sundaetguk.
How much is a bowl of sundaetguk here?
On cold days, I crave hot sundaetguk.
I put rice in the sundaetguk and ate it.

examples.ko: 이 집 순댓국은 국물이 진하고 구수해요.
examples.en: This place's sundaetguk has a rich, savory broth.

explain: 소리 내서는 [순대꾹]이라 말하지만 사이시옷 때문에 '순댓국'이라고 써요. 보통 새우젓이나 깍두기를 곁들여 먹어요.

phrases.en: One bowl of sundaeguk, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 식당에서 주문할 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A phrase for ordering at a restaurant.

phrases.en: There is a good sundaeguk restaurant near my office.
phrases.nuance_ko: 순댓국을 파는 식당을 부르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The word for a restaurant that sells sundaeguk.

phrases.en: I always order sundaeguk.
phrases.nuance_ko: 메뉴를 고를 때 '먹다' 대신 '시키다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 시키다 for ordering a menu item.

explain_en: It is pronounced [순대꾹] but spelled with the sai-siot, as '순댓국'. It is usually eaten with salted shrimp or kkakdugi (radish kimchi).

examples.en: Green grapes are sweet and sour.
I bought a bunch of green grapes at the market.
I washed the green grapes and put them in the fridge.
I ordered a green grape ade at the cafe.

examples.ko: 이 청포도는 씨가 없어서 먹기 편해요.
examples.en: These green grapes have no seeds, so they are easy to eat.
My child likes green grapes, so I buy them often.

explain: 보라색 포도와 구분해서 초록색 포도를 말할 때 써요. 껍질째 먹는 경우가 많고, 음료나 케이크 이름에도 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: In summer I often drink green grape juice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 청포도로 만든 음료를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A drink made with green grapes.

phrases.en: I ate a green grape flavored candy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 과자나 음료의 맛 이름에 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for flavors of snacks and drinks.

phrases.en: The green grapes look sweeter.
phrases.nuance_ko: '청포도'를 쉬운 말로 풀어 쓴 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easy way to say 청포도.

explain_en: It distinguishes green grapes from the purple kind. They are often eaten with the skin, and the name often appears in drinks and cakes.

en: cup ramen; instant noodles in a cup

examples.en: I was hungry, so I ate cup ramen at night.
I pour hot water into the cup ramen.
I packed cup ramen when I went on a trip.
You can eat cup ramen at the convenience store.
You have to wait three minutes for cup ramen.

examples.ko: 컵라면이 너무 짜서 물을 많이 마셨어요.
examples.en: The cup ramen was too salty, so I drank a lot of water.

explain: 냄비에 끓이는 건 '라면', 컵에 물만 부어 먹는 건 '컵라면'이에요. 라면은 '끓이다'를 쓰지만 컵라면은 '물을 붓다'와 함께 말해요. 한국 편의점에는 뜨거운 물 기계와 먹는 자리가 있어서 그 자리에서 바로 먹는 사람이 많아요.

phrases.en: I pour hot water into the cup ramen and wait three minutes.
phrases.nuance_ko: 컵라면은 끓이지 않고 물을 부어서 만들어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Cup ramen is made by pouring water, not by boiling.
phrases.en_equiv: to pour water into cup ramen

phrases.en: I ate cup ramen at the convenience store.
phrases.nuance_ko: 컵라면과 가장 기본으로 함께 쓰는 동사예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic verb used with cup ramen.

phrases.en: One cup ramen, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가게에서 살 때 개수를 붙여 간단히 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A simple way to ask for one when buying at a store.

explain_en: Ramen cooked in a pot is 'ramyeon', while the kind you just add water to is 'keopramyeon'. You 'boil' (끓이다) ramyeon but 'pour water' (물을 붓다) for cup ramen. Many Korean convenience stores have a hot water machine and a seating area, so people eat it right there.

examples.en: I made French toast on Saturday morning.
This café's French toast is delicious.
I poured plenty of syrup on the French toast.

examples.ko: 달걀이랑 우유만 있으면 프렌치토스트 만들 수 있어요.
examples.en: With just eggs and milk, you can make French toast.
One French toast and a coffee for brunch, please.
French toast is fine even when made with stale bread.

explain: 그냥 '토스트'는 빵을 굽거나 달걀, 채소를 넣은 간식을 말하는 경우가 많고, '프렌치토스트'는 달걀물에 적셔서 구운 빵이에요. 카페 메뉴에서 자주 보고, 보통 시럽이나 과일과 함께 먹어요.

phrases.en: I made French toast this morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빵을 팬에 굽는 일이라 '굽다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Since you cook it in a pan, it goes with 굽다.

phrases.en: French toast with syrup on top is delicious.
phrases.nuance_ko: 자주 같이 먹는 것을 붙여서 설명해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adds what it is commonly eaten with.

phrases.en: Excuse me, one plate of French toast, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 카페나 식당에서 주문할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when ordering at a cafe or restaurant.

explain_en: Plain '토스트' often means grilled bread or a snack with egg and vegetables, while '프렌치토스트' is bread soaked in egg mixture and pan-fried. You often see it on café menus, usually served with syrup or fruit.

examples.ko: 계란을 깨서 흰자와 노른자를 잘 섞어요.
examples.en: Crack the egg and mix the white and the yolk well.

examples.ko: 케이크를 만들 때 흰자만 따로 거품을 내요.
examples.en: When making a cake, I whip only the egg whites separately.

examples.ko: 저는 흰자는 좋아하는데 노른자는 안 먹어요.
examples.en: I like the white, but I don't eat the yolk.

examples.ko: 다이어트 중이라서 삶은 달걀 흰자를 먹어요.
examples.en: I'm on a diet, so I eat boiled egg whites.

examples.ko: 흰자가 아직 투명하면 덜 익은 거예요.
examples.en: If the white is still clear, it isn't cooked yet.
I can see blood vessels in the white of my eye and I'm worried.

explain: 반대되는 말은 '노른자'예요. 눈의 흰 부분은 '흰자위'라고 하는 경우가 많고, 반대말은 '검은자위'예요.

phrases.en: I collect just the egg whites separately.
phrases.nuance_ko: 음식 만들 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing when cooking.

phrases.en: I eat the white and the yolk separately.
phrases.nuance_ko: 반대말 '노른자'와 함께 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used together with its opposite, the yolk.

phrases.en: I'm on a diet, so I only eat the whites.
phrases.nuance_ko: '만'을 붙여 흰자만 고를 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '만' means choosing only the white.

explain_en: Its opposite is '노른자' (yolk). For the white part of the eye, people often say '흰자위', and its opposite is '검은자위'.
